land.text: Antigua, with Barbuda (infobox 'Union: 1 August 1860') and Redonda (infobox 'Redonda: 26 March 1872'), 'Part of the Leeward Islands colony'

predecessors.note: Associated state from 27 February 1967, sovereign from 1 November 1981. Cliopatria's British Colonial Empire shape holds Antigua's cell to 1968 and holds neither the Barbuda nor the Redonda cell.

correction.text: Antigua with Barbuda and the dependency of Redonda: 'The island of Barbuda maintains much autonomy, while the island of Antigua is directly governed by the national government'; 'The dependency of Redonda is part of the parish of Saint John under the Redonda Annexation Act'

keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's 1967 shape is Antigua alone (bbox 16.94 to 17.19 N, 61.87 to 61.62 W; 586 km2 against the infobox 440 km2 for the whole state, ratio 1.33, inside a factor of two but a crude six-vertex outline). Barbuda (its gazetteer cell lies near 17.70 N) and Redonda (near 62.5 W) are outside it, though the page makes both part of the state. The correction adds the two islands. The start year 1967 matches the page: associated state on 27 February 1967.

correction.text: Antigua with Barbuda and the dependency of Redonda, as in 1967

keyframe_review.note: Identical to the 1967 shape, so the same two islands are missing; the page records no territorial change since 1872.

region.text: Antigua, Barbuda and Redonda as an associated state of the United Kingdom with full internal autonomy

ledger.note: 27 February 1967: Antigua becomes an associated state. 'became an associated state of the United Kingdom with full internal autonomy on 27 February 1967.' Second page (West Indies Associated States): the association rested on the West Indies Act 1967 and the UK kept responsibility for 'external affairs' and 'defence', so the state is a UK client until 1981 (the vassal pair belongs in the British dossier). Cliopatria's British shape keeps Antigua's cell to 1968.

1 November 1981: full independence. 'Eventually, Antigua and Barbuda gained full independence on 1 November 1981'; the association with the UK ends (West Indies Associated States table: 'Antigua: 1 November 1981'). Same state, land and colour; it is now a Commonwealth realm. The associated state was 'the Associated State of Antigua' (Antigua and Barbuda page; 'Antigua' in the West Indies Associated States table), so the event is also the change of name to Antigua and Barbuda.

certainty.note: Islands: the coast is the frontier; the pages record no boundary dispute or territorial change since the union of Barbuda (1860) and Redonda (1872). Redonda sits some 40 km south-west of Antigua per the page.

notes: Page budget 2 of 2 (Antigua and Barbuda, West Indies Associated States). Start year: Cliopatria's shape begins in 1967 with associated statehood (27 February 1967); full sovereignty comes on 1 November 1981 and is coded as a rename (status change) so that the colour and dossier continue. The associated-state period 1967-1981 is a client relation of the United Kingdom: the vassal_start (1967, counterpart antigua-and-barbuda) and vassal_end (1981) belong in the british-colonial-empire dossier (eu-11); this dossier does not code them because the relation is recorded by the suzerain. Cliopatria's shape holds Antigua only and omits Barbuda and Redonda (checked against the gazetteer cells: Barbuda about 17.70 N 61.86 W, Redonda about 17.17 N 62.51 W); Cliopatria's British shape does not hold them either, so those two cells come from no Cliopatria state; the correction is carried in the keyframe and the found event, the eu-11 dossier should account for them. The 1967-1968 overlap with the British shape is Cliopatria's. Redonda is not otherwise dated on the page beyond the infobox date 26 March 1872 and the Redonda Annexation Act (undated). The page does not describe Barbudan secession moves before the recent movement (undated). Reviewer am-08-j (2026-10-19): west-indies-federation moved out of predecessors, which list the states whose land this state took at its birth: the Federation was disestablished on 31 May 1962 (Federation infobox), five years before the associated state, and the west-indies-federation dossier hands the island to british-colonial-empire. Antigua 'became part of the short-lived West Indies Federation from 1958 to 1962' (Antigua and Barbuda page). The page calls the 1967-1981 state 'the Associated State of Antigua' (added to alt_names).
